tools.name: get_latest_rates
tools.description: Returns the most recent TCMB exchange-rate bulletin (TRY per unit of foreign currency). Source: Central Bank of the Republic of Türkiye (CBRT/TCMB) daily indicative bulletin, published on business days around 15:30 Türkiye time (UTC+3). Rates are TRY per `unit` of currency (JPY is per 100). Decimals

tools.name: get_rates_on_date
tools.description: Returns the TCMB bulletin published on a given date (history back to 1996). If no bulletin was published that day (weekend, holiday, or today before ~15:30 TRT), returns the previous bulletin with is_fallback=true and a fallback_reason. tools.name: convert_currency
tools.description: Converts an amount between two currencies using TCMB rates. TRY may be either side. Cross conversions (e.g. USD to EUR) go through TRY using the same rate_type on both legs. Returns the result (6 decimals), the effective rate and a calculation breakdown. Omit date for the latest bulletin. Source: Ce

tools.name: list_currencies
tools.description: Lists currencies in the latest TCMB bulletin with English/Turkish names, quoting unit and which rate types are published for each. Use it to check codes before calling the other tools.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "list_currencies" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Lists currencies in the latest TCMB bulletin with English/Turkish names, quoting unit and which rate types are published for each. Use it to check codes before …

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.
